mean_cn: v.分开；裂开；被撕破；撕裂；  n.分裂；不和；裂缝
mean_en: to divide, or to make a group of people divide, into smaller groups that have very different opinions; to divide something into two or more parts and share it between different people, activities, etc.
sentence: They split up after their relationship fell apart.
sentence_trans: 他们感情破裂后就分开了。
